0022600187.text: The Magic (2-5, 0-4 at home, 2-1 on the road) enter this game on a two-game losing streak and sit 5th in the Southeast, 2 games back, while the Suns (1-4) have lost three straight and sit 3rd in the Pacific, 3.5 games back. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), and Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain). The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Magic won the last meeting 115-111 in Orlando on March 31, 2026, while no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series.
